settings.headline:
EVERY TOOL.
THE RIGHT order.
settings.subtext: A five-piece oral care system, in two versions, manual or electric. Precision tools designed to work in sequence. Made for people who take the small rituals seriously.

settings.title: Angled Floss Pick
settings.description: Start between the teeth. Reach every gap, even the back molars.

settings.title: Brush Teeth
settings.description: Every surface. 45° angle. No missed corners.

settings.title: Tuft Brush
settings.description: Precision finish. Behind the back teeth and around tight spots.

settings.title: Tongue Brush
settings.description: Loosen the coating. Bristles work into the crevices.

settings.title: Tongue Scraper
settings.description: One smooth pull lifts everything you loosened.

settings.heading:
FIVE STEPS.
ONE system.
settings.intro: This isn't a generic checklist. It's a sequence built around how each tool actually works, floss to disrupt, brush to clean, then a two-step finish on the tongue. Loosen first, then lift it all off.

settings.heading:
TWO KITS.
one SYSTEM.
settings.description: Same five-step routine, your choice of brush. Bristles wear out and floss runs low, so your subscription sends a fresh refill every 90 days for £18, the same cadence dentists recommend for replacing a brush head.

settings.question: What comes in the starter kit?
settings.answer: The full five-tool system: angled floss pick, toothbrush, tuft brush, tongue brush, and stainless steel tongue scraper, all housed in a zippered travel case. Choose the Electric Kit for a USB-C rechargeable brush, or the Manual Kit for a soft-bristle manual one.

settings.question: How does the subscription work?
settings.answer: You get the full kit once. After that, we send a refill every 90 days for £18, containing the parts that wear out. Your case and tongue scraper stay with you.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Not yet. We're UK-only for now while we build the brand at home. International shipping is on the roadmap, join our newsletter to be the first to know when we cross borders.

settings.question: Do I need to use all five tools?
settings.answer: Yes, that's the point. Each tool plays a specific role, and the routine only works as a system. Every step is short (under 90 seconds), and together they add up to a genuinely complete clean.

settings.question: Can I pause or cancel my subscription?
settings.answer: Anytime. Log into your account and pause, skip a delivery, change your refill frequency, or cancel entirely. No calls, no forms, no friction.
